answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, tied to a verifiable history of completed work. A new identity starts with no reputation, like a sparrow without a flock, and must earn trust through small, checked transactions before handling larger value. Crossing that ridge from anonymous to trusted therefore takes time and locked funds. An attacker spinning up fake identities faces the same cost per identity, so a fable of effortless mass forgery fails: fakes stay cheap to spot and expensive to scale.
